note: City of Park Falls park on the east bank of the North Fork Flambeau River, inside the city off Atwood Ave (enter north on Saunders Ave, then left on Atwood). Two fishing piers, boat launch, playground and courts share the park. --Claude
summary: City page (archived Apr 2026; city domain now hijacked): 9 sites W/S/20-30-50A, $35 RV / $25 tent, FCFS only, restrooms summer only, dump off-site at city garage. Riverfront -> riverview proposed (no site map; nearest pads ~45 m behind a path and a shrub-lined bank). Phone empty -> 715-762-2436.
flags: WATERFRONT riverfront -> riverview (downgrade, for the reviewer): no site map or site numbers are published, so no named site can be shown within ~50 m. On Esri imagery the camping loop (about 45.9401,-90.4400 to 45.9405,-90.4407) has its nearest pads about 45 m from the North Fork Flambeau (a wide flowage here) across mown lawn and the riverside walking path, with a narrow shrub/tree fringe on the bank itself; the river is in plain view across the lawn.
PHONE empty -> 715-762-2436 (City of Park Falls City Hall, on the archived city page; also travelwisconsin.com).
